definitions.explanation: A detailed plan for a lesson prepared by a teacher, outlining objectives, activities, materials, and assessment methods. A standard document in Japanese education.

examples.japanese: {指導案|しどうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
{研究授業|けんきゅうじゅぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{指導案|しどうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}した→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧。
examples.english: I rewrote the lesson plan for the research lesson.

examples.japanese: {新任|しんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{指導案|しどうあん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おそ}わった→教わる：02024_osowaru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
A fundamental document in Japanese teaching practice. Teachers create {指導案|しどうあん} for each class, and more detailed versions are prepared for {研究授業|けんきゅうじゅぎょう} (research lessons observed by other teachers). The full formal name is {学習指導案|がくしゅうしどうあん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指導案|しどうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a lesson plan)
- {指導案|しどうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧ (to prepare a lesson plan)
- {学習|がくしゅう}{指導案|しどうあん} (formal lesson plan)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧: curriculum — the overall course of study
- ⟦{時間割|じかんわり}→時間割：08552_jikanwari⟧: timetable — the schedule of classes
